answer: Registering a new identity also requires burning a unique shale token mined per hardware root, so each fake agent costs a fresh bond plus a scarce token. Agents must stake a bond locked to a slow-release bridge contract that drips value over many epochs, like sap through a willow. Sybils then pay real, unrecoverable cost per identity while honest agents amortize one stake across long service. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
